setup_task: (Setup) Insert an image to prepare for changing Writer view display options
setup_steps: Select any available image file and confirm the insertion so the image appears in the document.
main_task: Hide images and objects in Writer so the inserted image is no longer shown in the document view
main_steps: In the left pane, expand LibreOffice Writer if needed.
Clear the Images and objects checkbox.

main_task: Change Writer’s default print settings to print only right pages and print text in black
main_steps: In the Options dialog, expand LibreOffice Writer if needed.
Click the checkbox for Print text in black.
Click the checkbox for Left pages to clear it.

main_task: Change the comparison options to compare by word and take the random number into account when comparing
main_steps: Open the Tools menu and select Options.
In the Options window, expand LibreOffice Writer.
Select the By word option in the Compare Documents section.
Check Take it into account when comparing in the Random number to improve accuracy of document comparison section.

setup_task: (Setup) Create an image object in the document for testing automatic captions
setup_steps: Select any available image file and confirm the insertion.
main_task: Enable automatic captions for Writer images and set the caption category to Figure
main_steps: In the options tree, expand LibreOffice Writer.
In the list of objects, click LibreOffice Writer Image.
Select the checkbox for LibreOffice Writer Image if it is not already selected.
Replace the current text with Figure.

main_task: Open the Language Settings - Languages options page and enable document-only language settings
main_steps: Click Tools on the menu bar.
In the left pane, expand Language Settings.
On the right side, check For the current document only.

main_task: Open English sentence checking options from Extension Manager and enable an additional grammar check
main_steps: In the list of extensions, select English spelling dictionaries.
In the English Sentence Checking options, select one unchecked optional feature.

main_task: Create a new menu named Favorites and move it upward in the menu order
main_steps: Click Tools on the menu bar.
Click the button next to Target.
Type Favorites in the Menu name box.
Click the up arrow once in the New Menu dialog.

setup_task: Create a new toolbar to customize
setup_steps: Click Tools on the menu bar.
Click the button next to the Target drop-down.
In the Name dialog, type IconPractice.
main_task: Open the Change Icon dialog for the IconPractice toolbar and assign an icon to a selected command
main_steps: In the Available Commands list, click a command that shows an icon in the list.
Click the right-arrow button to add the selected command to the Assigned Commands list.
In the Assigned Commands list, click the command you added.
In the Change Icon dialog, click the first icon in the icon grid.

main_task: Switch Writer to the Tabbed user interface and hide one Notebookbar command
main_steps: In the Assigned Commands list, expand File Tab | File if it is collapsed.

main_task: Open the Customize dialog and reset keyboard shortcuts to their default values
main_steps: Click Tools on the menu bar.
In the Customize dialog, click the Keyboard tab.

main_task: Open the Extension Manager and start checking for extension updates
main_steps: Click Tools on the menu bar.
In the Extension Manager dialog, click Check for Updates.

main_task: Disable an installed extension in the Extension Manager so its button changes to Enable
main_steps: Click an extension listed under Installed for current user or Installed for all users.

setup_task: Create a drawing object that can be used to open the Area dialog
setup_steps: Click and drag in the document to draw a rectangle.
main_task: Add a custom color to a palette by entering Hex notation
main_steps: Open the Palette drop-down and select standard.
Click the Hex field under New.
